movie.title: Life in a Year
movie.overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.

facts: Turns out, 'Life in a Year' was a bit of a family affair! Jaden Smith's parents, Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith, served as executive producers on the film through their company, Overbrook Entertainment.

The film was brought to life by director Mitja Okorn, working from a screenplay penned by the writing duo Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. It’s always cool to know the specific creative team behind a movie!

Prepare for a truly unique premise: the story centers on a 17-year-old who, upon learning his girlfriend is dying, embarks on a mission to give her an entire lifetime of experiences within her last year.
